FarmerMText_SickCow:
My MILTANK ain't
givin' me milk n'more.

This here FARM's
got famous milk.

Most everyone
wants a drink.

It'll give me lots
o' milk if'n I

feed it lots o'
BERRIES, I reckon.
FarmerMText_BuyMilk:
How'd you like my
MOOMOO MILK?

It's my pride and
joy, there.

Give it to #MON
to restore HP!

I'll give it to ya
fer just ¥{d:ROUTE39FARMHOUSE_MILK_PRICE}.
FarmerMText_GotMilk:
Here ya go!
Drink up'n enjoy!
FarmerMText_NoMoney:
Sorry, there.
No cash, no sale!
FarmerMText_NoSale:
You don't want it?
Come again, hear?
FarmerMText_Milking:
I best go do my
milkin'.
FarmerFText_InTrouble:
Our milk even goes
out to KANTO.

So if our own
MILTANK won't give

us any milk, we're
in trouble.
FarmerFText_HealedMiltank:
You fixed our
MILTANK, hon. Now

it gives MOOMOO
MILK again.

Here's somethin'
fer your trouble.
FarmerFText_SnoreSpeech:
That there's
SNORE.

It's a rare move
that only works

while the #MON
is asleep.

You best think how
you ought to use it, hon.
